entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this ridiculous helmet I bought. I've been on hold for ten minutes. This is unacceptable.
I certainly apologize for the wait time. I can definitely look into starting a return for you. To get started, can I get your name and order number?
The name is Mike Sterling, S-T-E-R-L-I-N-G. Order number is VF88192. Just process the return. I don't have time for a bunch of questions.
Thank you, Mr. Sterling. I see the order for the Aero Road Helmet here. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item?

What's the issue?! The issue is I don't want it! The color is hideous, nothing like the pictures. I'm not putting this on my head. I don't care about its five-star safety rating, I'm not wearing it. The box is unopened, still sealed. Just take it back!
I understand your frustration with the color discrepancy. I just need to quickly confirm our return eligibility. Please hold for one moment.

Don't you dare put me on hold again! This is ridiculous. I'm a VIP member, I spend thousands here. If you can't handle this, get me a manager right now! I'm one click away from leaving a review that will scorch your brand.

No need for a manager, Mr. Sterling, and my apologies. I'm not putting you on hold. I'm pulling up the policy right now... Okay. I see your purchase was delivered 28 days ago. Looking at our policy for standard items like this helmet, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you immediately.
Well, good. See how easy that was? Should have been the first thing you did.

You're right, and I apologize for the friction. I've just initiated the return. You will receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 5 minutes. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any shipping center. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method.

And Mr. Sterling, as a valued VIP member, I want to sincerely apologize for your experience today. I've gone ahead and added a credit to your account for free expedited shipping on your next two orders. We appreciate your business and hope we can get you a product you're much happier with next time.
Oh. Okay. Well... thank you. I appreciate that. That's good service.
Of course. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
